label: letter s input during the original phase
explanation: Token detector: fires whenever the input token is s during the original (pre-<DEL>) phase, at any position and any L (dev F1 0.998, mass recall 0.9999). Does NOT fire on any other token, on the delimiter, or on s when it is fed back during the copy phase (only 347 tiny <=0.06 activations there, ~0% of mass, on copied s at recall_idx 1). Magnitude is highest for s early in the sequence (top examples are all s at t=1, typically after 2) and weaker for s later in the sequence and for repeated occurrences of s (in_first=0 steps carry only 7.5% of mass; lowest-quartile examples are late or second s).

issues: No systematic counterexample found. Test split: precision 1.0, recall 0.997, F1 0.998, mass recall 0.99985. There are 0 false positives.
